name: Cable Standing Row
steps: Stand facing a low pulley with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Grip the handle with both hands at arm's length and brace your core with a tall chest.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows straight behind you.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly, then extend your arms forward under control.
tips: Keep your torso still as your shoulder blades glide backward.
Avoid leaning backward to yank the handle or letting your shoulders shrug upward.
